live_contract_snapshot.capture_note: Official metadata captured within the 300-second freshness threshold using the subsequent /fapi/v1/time response. Binance is a research proxy only; execution venue is unconfirmed.

LINEAR_BASE_QUANTITY.required_multiplier: positive base units per exchange quantity unit; must be explicit

INVERSE_FIXED_QUOTE_FACE.required_multiplier: positive quote face value per contract; must be explicit

rounding.filter_grid_anchor: Binance PRICE_FILTER uses minPrice + integer*tickSize; LOT_SIZE and MARKET_LOT_SIZE use minQty + integer*stepSize.
rounding.post_rounding: Recheck directional geometry, price bounds, limit and market quantity grids/bounds, entry and protective-exit minimum notionals, margin notional cap and all-in stop loss. Reject any invalid plan.
rounding.protective_exit_order_assumption: Validate both SL and TP against market lot and configured minimum exit notional; actual venue exit order types must be verified before deployment.

per_trade_risk.basis: user-confirmed maximum total trade loss including fees and slippage; not a guaranteed maximum during gaps, liquidation or venue failure
per_trade_risk.actual_fill_reconciliation: recompute projected all-in PnL at a stressed stop from supplied average fills, realized partial exits, recorded fees and funding, current mark/equity, planned quantity and protective coverage; entry locking is explicit
per_trade_risk.live_sizing_policy: BLOCK unless venue filters, account fee rates, adverse-slippage reserve and funding treatment are supplied. Paper fixtures may pass explicit synthetic assumptions.

user_account_locks.status: DISABLED_BY_USER_REQUEST; do not substitute project research values or imply a personal lock is active
user_account_locks.user_choice: The user explicitly chose to leave personal daily-loss and drawdown thresholds unset.
user_account_locks.daily_reset: UTC day boundary; establish the new day baseline from current marked equity including open unrealized PnL, then measure subsequent equity changes
user_account_locks.drawdown_reset: latched until explicit operator reset while flat with no pending entry; never silently reset at a date boundary
user_account_locks.lock_actions: block new entries; request cancellation of a pending entry but retain its identity through terminal status; preserve every active protective exit; do not automatically flatten by an unverified primitive

paper_ledger.equity_quote: initial equity + realized gross PnL - commissions + signed funding cashflows + unrealized marked PnL
paper_ledger.fill_accounting: process each partial fill at its own price, quantity and fee; update average entry and protected quantity from the remaining position; reject over-close/reversal without mutating the ledger; expose any position protection-coverage gap
paper_ledger.open_risk_reconciliation: compare supplied actual fills, partial exits, fees and funding with planned quantity and stressed-stop all-in loss using current mark and protection coverage; fixtures are synthetic until real exchange fills are supplied
paper_ledger.per_trade_loss_lock: optional; latch on marked or realized trade loss at or beyond the configured cap; preserve protection and require an explicit flat/no-pending reset; does not set a daily or drawdown limit
paper_ledger.funding_accounting: record signed quote-denominated funding events supplied by a source ledger; do not assume a fixed interval or synthesize a zero rate
paper_ledger.gaps: stop slippage/gap loss can exceed the $1 intended budget; report the breach, latch the optional per-trade loss lock, block entries and preserve protection; no hard cap is guaranteed
paper_ledger.utc_reset: apply the first observed mark at the UTC boundary before establishing the new daily-equity baseline, avoiding double-counting an overnight gap
paper_ledger.pending_entry: block new pending orders while any configured lock is latched; retain identity of existing entry through cancel request and terminal resolution
paper_ledger.portfolio_scope: deterministic paper/reference ledger only; no live account, liquidation tier, margin availability or exchange fills

holding_time.user_policy: TP/SL only; no maximum hold time
holding_time.future_exit_changes: register as a separately versioned exit-policy experiment; do not change entry logic silently

takeprofit_native_limits.tick_size_note: Context.info.tick_size is documented and inherited by MainStrategyContext. The research-proxy snapshot captured a 0.10 BTCUSDT tick; platform context must be checked against the selected chart instrument.
takeprofit_native_limits.policy: Do not treat available simulator cash as marked account equity. The native source uses configurable quantity-grid parameters sourced from the research-proxy snapshot; validate platform behavior and refresh filters before execution. Personalized daily/drawdown locks require documented account fields.

deployment_blockers: Binance is a research proxy only; actual execution venue is unconfirmed.

Native P1 strategy source now rounds prices to platform tick size and applies configurable captured Binance quantity/notional defaults. It compiles and passes runtime_quick on a disposable copy; native order/fill behavior is still unobserved.
Native P1 does not enforce the dynamic Binance PERCENT_PRICE reference-price bounds; this and order/fill behavior remain research-only until platform execution semantics are verified.
The public Binance metadata snapshot is fresh for the capture time, but must be recaptured before any future execution deployment.
Account fee rates and measured spread/slippage are unavailable.
Funding inclusion in the per-trade $1 cap is unspecified.
Personal daily-loss and drawdown locks are intentionally disabled by user choice; do not present them as active account protection.
TakeProfit strategy API documents available cash/position/instrument minimums, not account-level marked equity or daily PnL controls.
A stop-market order cannot guarantee the $1 cap through price gaps, liquidation or exchange failure.
